notes.cases: tUtcMs -> az/el, horizon, Sun fraction; earthVisible = earthElevDeg - earthHorizonDeg >= earthMarginDeg (no hysteresis). The first 240 are uniform random site x time; the rest are extra instants with the Sun disk partly hidden (0 < sunFraction < 1).
notes.scenarios: Brute-force 1-minute walk with engine hysteresis. Totals are minute counts over the half-open range [landing, landing + durationH): clip engine windows (closed range) at durationH before comparing. hourly.* has durationH + 1 samples taken on the hour (landing + i hours), so a window edge within a minute of an hour may flip that hourly flag. Compare event times and totals with the engine at about 1 minute per event (10 min total tolerance in SPEC-engine), not exactly. Gaps include those clipped by the mission window ends.
